hero.title: Apex is a pioneer in
hero.lead: Its sustainability efforts are driven by digitization, ecological cognizance, productivity, innovation, and adaptability.

approach.title: A three-pronged mechanism
approach.intro: Apex has a three-pronged mechanism for addressing sustainability: environmental friendliness, usage of recyclable materials, and mainstreaming corporate social responsibility efforts into its daily operations.

pillars.title: Environmental friendliness
points: One of the largest privately-owned water treatment plants in the country
Research into how to recycle wastewater
Environmentally friendly chemicals that adhere to ZDHC guidelines
Singeing and sublimation to minimize dye wastage and chemical usage

pillars.title: Usage of recyclable materials
points: Pre-consumer waste recycled into new fiber
Bamboo fiber, recycled polyester, recycled ocean plastic and organic cotton

pillars.title: Corporate social responsibility
points: On-premises medical and transport facilities for staff and family
Daycare centers with certified childcare givers for working mothers
Wellbeing training on financial literacy and nutrition
Fair Wage Method, developed with the ILO

water.title: Our commitment to environmental friendliness is multi-faceted
water.text: We have one of the largest privately-owned water treatment plants in the country where it researches how to recycle wastewater. Our factories use environmentally friendly chemicals that adhere to ZDHC (Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals) guidelines, to promote sustainable manufacturing.

steps.label: Water treatment plant
steps.text: One of the largest privately-owned in the country

steps.label: ZDHC chemicals
steps.text: Environmentally friendly chemicals that adhere to ZDHC guidelines

items.title: LED lighting
items.text: We made the switch to LED lights from CFL lights in all of our factories and offices.

items.title: Servo motors
items.text: We made the switch from clutch motors to servo motors in all of our factories and offices.

items.title: Waste heat
items.text: Our operations utilize waste heat from factory power generation and use it to power air-conditioning and cooling units.

items.title: IFC PaCT program
items.text: Our energy conservation initiatives extend to our dyeing houses as well, as a part of the International Finance Corporation’s (IFC) PaCT program.

items.title: Singeing and sublimation
items.text: We use singeing and sublimation in the manufacturing of our textiles to minimize dye wastage and chemical usage.

materials.title: Materials we work with
materials.intro: We recycle the pre-consumer waste produced in our manufacturing processes into new fiber.

items.name: Viscose made from FSC certified wood pulp
Viscose made from pre-consumer recycled cotton

grs.title: Global Recycle Standard (GRS)
grs.text: We are the Global Recycle Standard (GRS) certified, which means that we voluntarily allow third-party assessment of our recycling efforts.

loop.title: Promoting recycling
loop.intro: To integrate technological innovation into our sustainability initiatives and to promote recycling, we have collaboration with Reverse Resources to facilitate an online platform that allows a network of recycling spinners to access fabric scrap availability.

steps.label: Online platform
steps.text: Fabric scrap availability, with Reverse Resources.

steps.label: Recycling spinners
steps.text: A network of spinners accesses the scrap.

steps.label: New fiber
steps.text: Pre-consumer waste is recycled into new fiber.

people.title: We are determined to invest in our people
people.intro: We have mainstreamed corporate social responsibility into our operations and chooses to holistically develop our employees.
